name: Double Glitch
description: A hard cut hidden under a short burst of horizontal glitch: the frame slides and mirror-wraps, streaks smear sideways, the picture flashes a red tritone and splits its RGB channels. Recreation of the CapCut "Double Glitch" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.
